entities.summary: Robert Mandrou, was a French historian, one of the members of the Annales School and the secretary to its journal Annales d'Histoire Economique et Sociale. He was also, with Georges Duby one of the pioneers of what Annaliste historians in the 1970s and 80's came to call the "history of mentalities".
